competences.description: Attacks the enemy with claws and disturbs the enemy's HP recovery for 2 turns.
Dashes towards an enemy, inflicting damage 2 times. Each attack has a 40% chance to stun the target for 1 turn. The damage is proportionate to your MAX HP.

Inflicts 12% of your MAX HP as damage when you are attacked with a Critical Hit. In addition, inflicts Continuous Damage for 1 turn with a 50% chance and decreases the Defense for 1 turn with every attack. [Automatic Effect]
